
  /work/example

  Project-level MCP servers are disabled until you explicitly choose Trust.
  Trust starts the listed project MCP targets and remembers this folder.
  Project MCP targets:
    local (stdio): command=node args=["server.js"]
    tracker0 (stdio): command=uvx
    args=["--from","example-mcp","example-mcp-0"]
    cwd=/work/example
    tracker1 (stdio): command=uvx
    args=["--from","example-mcp","example-mcp-1"]
    cwd=/work/example
    tracker2 (stdio): command=uvx
    args=["--from","example-mcp","example-mcp-2"]
    cwd=/work/example

   ❯ Trust this folder
     Enable project MCP servers. Remembered for this folder.

     Don't trust
     Exit Kimi Code. Asked again next launch.
